heading: Sub-tenants and mortgage lenders
paragraphs: You must give details of any sub-tenants or mortgage lenders connected to the property. The court will tell them about this claim.
If your tenant has rented the property to someone else, that person is called an ‘underlessee’. If you have a mortgage on the property, your lender is called a ‘mortgagee’.
An underlessee or mortgagee may be able to ask the court to cancel a possession order. This is called ‘relief from forfeiture’.
